t01-twin-girls-16.observed_description: Identical twin sisters (long straight dark-brown hair, light-green T-shirts) sit behind two cakes whose green number candles both read 16.
t01-twin-girls-16.note: Usable: the twins read as identical and both numbers read 16 at 360 px. Kept out of four-picture cards (candles are small at 180 px).

t02-twin-boys-18.observed_description: Identical twin brothers (short black curly hair, navy T-shirts) sit behind two cakes whose orange number candles both read 18.
t02-twin-boys-18.note: Usable: identical twins; both numbers read 18 at 360 px. Kept out of four-picture cards.

t03-boy17-girl19.observed_description: A boy (light-brown hair, red T-shirt) and his older sister (long wavy black hair, yellow T-shirt) behind cakes with candles 17 (blue) and 19 (pink).
t03-boy17-girl19.note: Usable: they clearly look different; 17 and 19 read at 360 px. Kept out of four-picture cards.

t04-friends-20.observed_description: Two young women who look nothing alike (short curly red hair in white; long straight black hair in purple) behind cakes whose white candles both read 20.
t04-friends-20.note: Usable: both 20s read at 360 px, the left one fainter against the white T-shirt; not twins. Kept out of four-picture cards.
